patch.value: Hard import gate, history-consistent timestamps, first-class import/export contracts

Three-part hardening vs pm-cli 2026.6.11: (1) the fail-fast malformed-JSONL import gate currently lives ONLY in the preflight override, a single-winner surface — co-installed with pm-todos it loses the slot (extension_preflight_override_collision) and 'pm beads import malformed.jsonl' exits 0 after PARTIALLY writing valid lines; move the authoritative validation inside the import core so it never depends on winning preflight, and drop the process.exit-based preflight override. (2) default timestamp preservation patches item files directly and trips pm health history_drift (hash_mismatches -> ok:false); follow each patch with the CLI-sanctioned 'pm history-repair <id>' re-anchor and revert the patch if repair is unavailable, keeping health green in all cases. (3) adopt the 2026.6.10 SDK ImportExportRegistrationOptions third argument so 'pm beads import/export --help' and runtime contracts carry real descriptions+flags. Plus manifest trust hardening (trusted/sandbox_profile/permissions/manifest_version/pm_min_version).
npm test, npm run typecheck green; changelog:check passes

value.text: Salvaged prior in-flight work (1062-line diff) reviewed line-by-line and adopted: (1) preflight override removed; authoritative fail-fast gate now lives in runImport via new assertBeadsImportable() which throws CommandError(GENERIC_FAILURE) before any pm-store write — immune to extension_preflight_override_collision when pm-todos co-installed. (2) applyTimestamps now follows every raw item-file patch with 'pm history-repair <id> --message ...' (verified present in CLI 2026.6.11); on repair failure the patch is REVERTED so pm health never sees history_drift. (3) registerImporter/registerExporter now pass the SDK 2026.6.10+ ImportExportRegistrationOptions third arg (description/intent/examples/failure_hints/flags); all FlagDefinitions carry canonical value_type. (4) manifest.json hardened mirroring first-party builtin-beads-import: manifest_version 1, trusted, sandbox_profile restricted, least-privilege permissions (process_spawn true — extension shells out to pm). devDep bumped to ^2026.6.11 (lockfile refreshed); peerDep floor stays >=2026.6.9 since options arg + value_type degrade gracefully on older hosts. Validated: build green, tsc clean, 59/59 tests.

value.author: codex
value.text: Gotchas: (1) The SDK preflight-override surface is single-winner — co-installed extensions collide (extension_preflight_override_collision) and the loser's gate silently never runs; never put correctness-critical validation there. (2) The SDK preflight runner also swallows thrown errors (downgraded to a warning), so even a winning preflight cannot reliably abort — fail-fast gates belong in the command/importer handler itself where a thrown CommandError yields a clean nonzero exit. (3) Raw item-file patches desync the per-item history hash chain; 'pm history-repair <id> --message ...' (CLI >=2026.6.9) is the sanctioned re-anchor and keeps 'pm health' ok:true — and if it ever fails, REVERT the patch rather than leaving drift. (4) Beads JSONL timestamp keys are created_at/updated_at, not created/updated. (5) 'pm install <bare-name> --project' resolves a LOCAL PATH; use 'pm install npm:<name> --project' for the npm registry.

patch.value: Shipped and functionally verified vs CLI 2026.6.11 in a throwaway workspace co-installed with npm pm-todos (which owns the preflight slot): malformed JSONL import exits 1 with ZERO items written; valid import preserves created_at/updated_at (timestamped 2) with pm health ok:true (no history_drift); pm validate ok; export/diff round-trip drift:false; 'pm beads import --help' surfaces the ImportExportRegistrationOptions contract. Build+tsc+59/59 tests green; changelog:check passes.
